neighbours.label: ' as' in the phrase 'as to' (doubt/debate/question as to ...)
fire: There is still some confusion as to who owns the land by the river.
The committee gave no guidance as to how the money should be spent.
Experts disagree as to whether the painting is genuine.
We have received no word as to when the shipment will arrive.
The letter left her uncertain as to his real intentions.
Opinions differ as to the best way to train a young dog.
There was some debate as to whether the match should go ahead.
The report offers few details as to the cause of the fire.
quiet: There is still some confusion, as many people claim the land by the river.
The committee met as usual to discuss how the money should be spent.
Experts regard the painting as genuine after the tests.
We will call you as soon as the shipment arrives.
The letter was written as a farewell to her old friend.
Many people see training as the best way to raise a young dog.
The match went ahead as planned despite the rain.
The report describes the fire as the worst in a decade.

notes: card: 30 of top 32 peaks are ' as' followed by ' to' after doubt/debate/determination; the output suppresses ' to'... (- pole promotes 'to'). Near misses use ' as' in other senses.
